snippet.title: Star Wars: Beyond Victory - A Mixed Reality Playset | Launch Trailer | Meta Quest
snippet.description:
Adventure, race, and play! ILM’s latest entry in immersive Star Wars storytelling, Beyond Victory, blends adventure, high-speed podracing, and open-ended play in a way only possible through mixed reality. Players can now step into the Star Wars galaxy and experience the action as it unfolds seamlessly within their own surroundings.

Get Beyond Victory Now: https://www.meta.com/experiences/star-wars-beyond-victory/9460903453969753/?srsltid=AfmBOorUQyiCRYKqV8w3Sb-EWvPvWNqwOH2WrlJn2F_Y-4_okzbCdwCu 

Star Wars: Beyond Victory has three distinct gameplay modes designed to offer a wide range of play styles. In Adventure Mode, experience an original Star Wars story from a bold new perspective by playing as an ambitious pilot mentored by podracing legend Sebulba. In Arcade Mode, transform your space into a holotable arena and master fast, top-down podracing with multiple paths and nonstop action. In Playset Mode, unleash your creativity in a dynamic sandbox using unlockable digital figures, vehicles and tools to create, pose and play your own Star Wars stories.

Set during the Reign of the Empire, Star Wars: Beyond Victory - A Mixed Reality Playset introduces players to an original story that blends the thrilling world of podracing, a stellar cast, powerful narrative and mixed-reality play.
